Druidic wanderer wrapped in a moss-robe of living green fabric, woven with vines and autumn leaves, deer-hide boots worn soft, oak-branch staff taller than her head, no metal anywhere, hemp rope belt, the forest itself clothing her in its colors.

Quel'Thalas ranger's fitted coral-pink leather coat ending at the hips, embroidered with silver thread in ancient patterns, cream undershirt visible at throat, dark brown trousers, knee-high boots of supple leather, twin blades crossed at her back, ears exposed through hood's careful cut.

Free-Folk hunter layered in caribou hide and wool, thick grey cloak lined with rabbit fur, leather trousers reinforced with hide patches, boots wrapped in additional furs against the permafrost, bone-white ivory ornaments at throat, spear in hand, no house sigils to mark allegiance.

Leyndell knight's golden-bronze armor catching every ray of light—engraved breastplate over a white surcoat, pauldrons shaped like lion's manes, chainmail skirt, steel greaves, heavy gauntlets, crimson cloak billowing behind, every piece proclaiming nobility and martial discipline.

Aen Seidhe scout in supple jade-green leather tunic belted twice, no cloak to snag on branches, dark grey trousers fitted for silent movement, soft boots allowing feel of earth beneath, ash-wood longbow across shoulders, quiver at hip, ears bare to catch forest whispers.

Calishite desert guide's sleeveless vest of tooled brown leather over a single thin under-layer of bone-white linen, loose amber trousers gathered at ankles, sandals reinforced with brass, wide scarf wrapped loosely at neck for sun protection, scimitar at hip, weathered and practical.

Mahakaman warrior's steel scale cuirass over a thick indigo wool shirt, chainmail collar protecting throat, dark leather trousers tucked into iron-shod boots, axe and hammer both at belt, rust-orange cloak pinned with a silver brooch, beard braided with iron rings.

Highgarden courtier turned adventurer—olive-green silk doublet over a cream linen shirt, practical leather riding breeches replacing court finery, low boots suitable for rough terrain, rapier at hip, silver embroidery at collar the only remaining luxury, hands callused from reins not needlework.

Liurnian knight wrapped in dark teal cloak over steel half-plate, amethyst-purple tabard bearing lunar insignia, chainmail beneath visible at joints, steel boots caked in swamp mud, gauntlets worn smooth from gripping hilt, helmet carried rather than worn, face scarred and sun-weathered.

Sleeveless gambeson in dusty saffron, bracered forearms wrapped in sun-bleached linen, sand-tan breeches tucked into calf-high boots—Hammerfell scout gear, road-tested through the Alik'r, no cloak to snag on stone.

Steel half-plate engraved with Gondorian tree motifs over a wine-red surcoat, pauldrons asymmetrical, greaves strapped tight—temperate cavalry armor that's seen three campaigns, dented but functional.
Forest-green hooded coat ending at the hip, reinforced elbows, charcoal wool inner layer visible at cuffs and collar—Dúnedain ranger silhouette, praktical for Eriador's rain and ambush.
No armor at all: indigo travel-robe belted at the waist, sleeves wide enough for spell gestures, hem split for riding—Carian Academy sorceress on the road, lightweight and unarmored.
Bearskin cloak over layered russet hide tunic, fur-trimmed boots to the knee, bone toggles at the throat—Nord hunter from Skyrim's Pale, built for weeks in the snow.
Oxblood leather cuirass tooled with Mahakaman dwarven knotwork, no undershirt, just the armor and dark teal breeches—mid-weight, sleeveless, built for alpine crossings in the Witcher's Pontar Valley.
Fitted linen riding tunic in cream, single-layer, no coat, olive breeches, low riding boots—Highgarden civilian style adapted for the Rose Road, light and breathable.
Chainmail hauberk ending mid-thigh over a thin gambeson, steel-grey and unadorned, hood down, gloves tucked into belt—Cormyrean man-at-arms gear, temperate and utilitarian.
Verdigris-bronze scale cuirass over a sand-tan under-tunic, leather skirt split for movement, forearms bare—Chultan jungle armor, lightweight and sweat-wicking, no excess fabric.
Cobalt wool cloak lined with fur, layered over charcoal wool tunic and trousers, boots wrapped in hide strips—Free Folk winter traveler from beyond the Wall, weathered and patched.
Single-piece monk's cassock in bone-white, rope-belted, sleeves rolled to elbows, barefoot in leather sandals—Western monastery pilgrim, flowing silhouette, no weapons visible.
Pewter chainmail coif and gorget, no body armor, just an amber linen tunic and dark trousers beneath—Bretonnic skirmisher, throat-protected but otherwise unarmored for speed.
Jade-green hide tunic stitched with sinew, fur-lined hood, antler toggles, leather leggings wrapped tight—Bosmer ranger from Valenwood, forest-camouflage and silent movement prioritized.
Coral-pink padded surcoat over chainmail, steel breastplate strapped overtop, pauldrons mismatched—Paladin of the Silver Hand, Stormwind heraldry faded, functional not decorative.
No cloak: just a fitted charcoal wool doublet, bardic embroidery at the cuffs, dark breeches, low boots—Waterdhavian minstrel on the Sword Coast, civilian and agile.
Amethyst-purple silk travel-robe layered over linen trousers, wide sleeves bound at wrists with brass cuffs—Thayan mage attire stripped of Red Wizard insignia, practical for long roads.
Russet leather coat to mid-calf, fur collar, layered wool beneath, gloves lined with fleece—Nilfgaardian officer's winter kit, Northern Realms cold, no embellishment.
Olive-drab wool tunic, knee-length, belted with leather, no armor, just a single dagger slung low—Shire halfling scout, temperate and unassuming, built for going unnoticed.
Ironforge-forged steel cuirass over a dark teal gambeson, pauldrons riveted, chainmail skirt to knees—Dwarven mountain guard armor, mid-weight, designed for tunnel fighting.
Sleeveless scale vest in bronze, arms wrapped in linen bandages, sand-tan linen trousers loose at the ankle—Khanduras desert mercenary, Diablo-canon, lightweight and heat-resistant.
Ash-grey wool cloak over layered furs, bone amulets at the throat, hide boots wrapped in sealskin—Forodwaith shaman from the Northern Waste, arctic survival gear, ritually marked.
Steel breastplate with Leyndell sun-motif, worn leather straps, chainmail sleeves, no helmet—Elden Ring knight-errant, temperate campaign armor, tarnished but serviceable.
Forest-green moss-robe bound with vine-rope, barefoot, fingers stained with herb-juice—Druidic wanderer from Hyjal, flowing and earth-toned, no metal anywhere.
Wine-red leather tunic fitted at the torso, sleeveless, dark wool breeches, forearm guards in steel—Aen Seidhe scout from the Witcher's Blue Mountains, mid-weight and agile.
No hood: just a charcoal wool surcoat over chainmail, steel vambraces, boots caked in road-dust—Imperial legionnaire from Cyrodiil, temperate and standard-issue, worn thin.

Sleeveless gambeson in oxblood quilted linen, Redguard scout's bracers wrapping both forearms, sand-tan breeches tucked into low desert boots, lightweight pack slung diagonal—built for Hammerfell's sun-blasted canyons, no cloak to snag on stone.

Gondorian ranger's forest-green leather coat ending at the hip, fitted wool trousers, steel-grey hooded cowl pushed back, twin daggers cross-strapped at the small of her back—temperate woodland pursuit gear, road-tested and silent.

No armor at all—just a cream linen riding tunic belted at the waist, dark teal breeches, knee-high leather boots, a satchel of scrolls, and a weathered staff; a Waterdhavian scribe traveling the Sword Coast roads under hired guard.

Carian sorceress in flowing indigo travel-robes edged with silver threadwork, wide sleeves bound at the wrists with velvet cuffs, soft leather shoes—Liurnian moonlight and stargazing made portable, no hood, hair pinned with bone combs.

Charcoal-grey scale cuirass over a thin russet under-tunic, half-skirt of layered leather strips, iron greaves, wolf-pelt mantle across shoulders—Nord shield-maiden descending from Skyrim's Pale, functional and brutal.

Stormwind cavalry officer's cobalt tabard over polished steel breastplate, white wool trousers, black riding boots to mid-calf, lion-crest pauldron on left shoulder only—temperate lowlands patrol uniform, parade-ready but bloodstained at the hem.

Dúnedain wanderer's olive-drab cloak clasped with pewter, fitted ranger leathers beneath in smoke-grey, no plate at all, boots wrapped in oiled cloth against marsh rot—Eriador bog-crossing gear, decades of mileage written into every seam.

Light tunic in saffron linen, sleeveless, belted twice with cord and brass rings, sand-colored breeches, Khanduras desert bracers on forearms, no pack—she carries water and a blade, nothing else, built for speed through Aranoch's dunes.

Ironforge dwarf-smith's verdigris-bronze breastplate hammered with clan runes, thick leather apron-skirt, wool sleeves in amber, steel-toed boots caked in forge-dust—mountain craftswoman on a supply run, hammer slung at hip.

Dornish sun-cloak in coral-pink linen draped over one shoulder, light leather vest in bone-white, loose trousers tucked into low sandals, twin short-swords crossed at her back—Red Mountain passes demand breathability and speed.

Nilfgaardian half-plate in blackened steel, wine-red surcoat bearing no crest, chainmail sleeves, tall boots, gauntlets resting on her belt—a deserter who kept the armor, fled south, and now hires her sword to Skellige fishing towns.

School-of-Wolf witcher's charcoal leather coat reinforced at shoulders and elbows, steel studs along the collar, dark grey trousers, twin swords crossed on her back—Northern Realms monster-hunting standard, battered but meticulously maintained.

Chultan jungle scout in sleeveless jade-green leather vest, lightweight breeches ending at the knee, forearm wraps soaked in insect repellent, machete on hip, no boots—bare feet grip wet stone better than any sole.

Thayan mage-knight's fitted purple cassock split for riding, steel pauldrons on both shoulders, pewter vambraces, soft leather boots—arcane and martial disciplines balanced, tattooed forearms visible when she casts, robe hem scorched from her own fire.

Rohirrim outrider's russet leather jerkin over cream wool shirt, dark green riding trousers, tall boots, horse-hair plume pinned to a steel circlet—temperate plains cavalry, light enough to scout, tough enough to survive ambush.

No coat, no cloak—just a fitted steel cuirass over a linen shirt in smoke-grey, leather trousers, gauntlets, greaves, a Cormyrean Purple Dragon pendant at her throat—she stripped down after three days in summer heat, pragmatism over ceremony.

Aen Seidhe ranger in moss-green hide jerkin stitched with silver thread, olive trousers, soft boots that leave no track, bow unstrung across her back—elven woodland craft adapted for human wars, silent and old.

Bearskin cloak over layered wool and fur, Stormcloak blue beneath, steel bracers, hide boots lined with rabbit fur, frost clinging to her braid—Nord rebellion gear for the coldest passes, designed to outlast sieges.

Leyndell knight-errant's engraved golden breastplate over royal-blue under-armor, white half-cape pinned at one shoulder, steel greaves, longsword in a gilded scabbard—Elden Ring pageantry turned practical after the capital fell, polish worn away by road dust.

Light scale cuirass in bronze over a thin sand-tan tunic, no sleeves, breeches in dark teal, Haradrim-style wrapped footwear, waterskin slung across chest—southern desert adaptation for a ranger who abandoned her northern wool.

Highgarden duelist's fitted doublet in forest-green silk, leather trousers, knee-high boots, rapier on hip, no armor—she relies on speed, not steel, and her coin purse jingles with tournament winnings.

Druidic moss-robe in living green and grey, belted with woven vine, bare arms save for wooden bracers, bare feet, staff carved from Hyjal oak—Azerothian wild-shaper who wears the forest, not against it.
Skellige raider's hide-and-fur vest over wool shirt, sealskin trousers, boots wrapped in sharkskin, twin axes on her belt—cold coastal island pragmatism, designed to dry fast and kill faster.

Calishite caravan-guard's lightweight scale vest in pewter over a saffron linen shirt, loose trousers in charcoal, leather boots, scimitar and buckler—desert crossroads mercenary work, functional without ceremony, sun-faded and sweat-stained.

Drow surface-ranger in dark grey leather armor reinforced with spider-silk panels, amethyst-purple cloak for night travel, twin daggers at hip, boots silent on stone—Underdark precision adapted to moonlit forests, magic-woven and lethal.
